claims: Every transition of the lifecycle matches the transition table of the frozen #sim-exam-policy island.

A late write after submit, after expiry and after abort is refused with a stable error id (E_SESSION_LATE_WRITE, E_SESSION_EXPIRED_WRITE, E_SESSION_ABORTED_WRITE), and the answers given before the terminal transition are preserved.
The advisory timer reads a monotonic clock: the 90 % threshold is a status indication only, the elapsed time keeps counting while the tab is hidden, and the expiry transition preserves the answers.
Answers are stored raw and unparsed; a serialised session deserialises to identical answers, flags and state.
Rapid navigation during a re-render loses no in-progress answer.
The terminal record carries the answers, the flags, the elapsed time and the form id.
The scripted session runs from the start screen to the terminal record and every transition conforms to the table.

The scripted answer/flag sequence (slots 1, 5 and 21 answered, slot 3 flagged, the full range navigated) produces exactly the expected map state, in the pure render state and in the rendered cells alike.
All 21 slots are reachable by pointer and by keyboard alone; the keyboard run answers and flags across all 21 slots without a single pointer event and the focus is never trapped.
The review screen carries the unanswered warning with role="alert", and the submission requires an explicit confirmation that the machine also enforces (E_SESSION_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED).
The exam render contains zero help-component markers and zero N16 chain step text; a practice render contains zero exam-session fields and zero exam answer content.
The mode registry maps mode to allowed components, and an unregistered component fails the render contract loudly with E_MODE_COMPONENT_NOT_ALLOWED.
The built artifact carries the policy island, the two runtime modules, the shell markup and the boot call, with no external script.
The two in-file smoke vectors run against the built artifact.

not_claimed: No official examination, grade or proctoring status: the timer is advisory and labelled as such.

No browser render, screen-reader, print or instructor acceptance: the accessibility evidence is a mechanical structural check (role="alert", aria-pressed, aria-current, focus movement); the renderer-level acceptance belongs to N22/N33/N34.
No keyword matching as semantic grading: N21 stores the payload raw and never grades it.
No claim that the four variants are four finished questions: they are four parameterisations of one family template.
No persisted session: the state lives in memory for as long as the page does, and no localStorage write happens.

official_programme_facts.note: The 2025 programme fixes no point weight, no question count, no pass mark, no allowed aid and no exact exam question type. The 21 slots, the 100 points and the three forms are the training policy of this simulator (PROPOSED).

policy_label: PROPOSED training policy (N21): 21 slots, 100 points, three forms and an advisory 180-minute timer. Official programme facts: seven topics, a written-on-paper examination and a maximum of 180 minutes. The timer is advisory and never claims an official rule.
